 Millions of people visit Gallup.com and Gallup News every month looking for research they trust and solutions that improve their work and life.  As a software engineer on the Consumer Engagement team, you'll modernize the systems that deliver and surface Gallup’s content around the world. * Develop and maintain high\-performance web applications that power Gallup's public\-facing digital experiences with an emphasis on scalability, accessibility and reliability

* Engineer the technical foundations that improve Gallup's discoverability across search engines and emerging AI experiences
* Design back\-end services, APIs and data models that support reliable content delivery and cross\-platform integrations, with attention to schema integrity and query performance
